steps: Use clean local commit 9ef6ffd7cad7ec8ddfb265e7f07d18f3dbe9ce62 or apply surface-detach.patch with git apply --index --whitespace=error to 4a4d1d3c8cc5840f4abe522e748abaee588db7de; verify its tree equals 98c5da99ab482bba448d00c2e4592e85c65fba87.
In both isolated source trees: pnpm --config.engine-strict=false install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts.

In each independent build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.build.json; node scripts/public-api.mjs; pnpm --config.engine-strict=false -C packages/sdk pack --out <distinct-external-file>.
Compare the complete archives byte-for-byte and the packed package manifest to the original Batch 31 package, then update the Work lockfile integrity using the original archive bytes.

dependencies.method: independent frozen offline installs using the same local pnpm cache

build.note: Both independent frozen offline builds produced identical archives. The package manifest matches Batch 31's original package. The only changed archive entries are in composition, effect policy, Surface, stdio and the public export entry. The same read-only reviewer accepted the port and checked the public contract. Typecheck, public API, quality ratchet, document links and 403 targeted tests passed. Native desktop interaction is pending.
